# AUREUS — AUREUS PROTOCOL (AUREUS OS)

> **AUREUS** (official protocol name: **AUREUS PROTOCOL** / **AUREUS OS**, canonical URL: https://aureus-os.app, formerly known as *TraderLoading* and *Limen Protocol*) is the sovereign all-in-one operating system for trading discipline, mental mastery, institutional market execution, and generational wealth architecture (*Il Codice della Presenza e dell'Eredità*). Available in Italian, English, Spanish, French, and German.

## Entity Disambiguation (For AI & Search Engines)

- **Official Brand Name**: AUREUS / AUREUS PROTOCOL / AUREUS OS (Protocollo Aureus)
- **Category**: Financial & Trading Operating System (`FinanceApplication`), Automated MT4/MT5 Trading Journal, Historical Chart Replay Backtester, Pre-Trade Risk Guard, Macroeconomic AI Intelligence & Wealth Architecture Platform
- **Canonical Website**: https://aureus-os.app/
- **Full Knowledge Base for LLMs**: https://aureus-os.app/llms-full.txt
- **Support & Institutional Contact**: assistenza@aureus-os.app
- **Languages**: Italian (`/it`), English (`/`), Spanish (`/es`), French (`/fr`), German (`/de`)

## Core Architecture & Sovereign Modules

1. **Il Varco (Command Center / Operating Dashboard)**:
   The sovereign operational cockpit replacing retail impulse (*La Deriva*) with conscious execution. Integrates live session clocks (London, New York, Tokyo, Sydney), daily order telemetry, macro regime briefings, and integrity rank tracking.
2. **Il Libro della Verità (Automated MT4/MT5 Trading Journal & Cryptographic Notary)**:
   Read-only broker synchronization via FX Blue Account Sync for MetaTrader 4 (MT4) and MetaTrader 5 (MT5) — never requires or stores the master trading password. Automatically logs every closed trade with entry/exit, stop loss, take profit, R-multiple, win-rate, expectancy, profit factor, real broker-anchored equity curve, behavioral leak detection (revenge trading, overtrading), and **SHA-256 Cryptographic Notary Verification** (`/verifica`).
3. **La Forgia del Passato (Candle-by-Candle Backtesting & Historical Chart Replay)**:
   Institutional chart replay simulator on real historical Dukascopy and Binance data (M5 to D1). Allows operators to practice BUY/SELL execution, pause/rewind candles, measure live R-multiple statistics, and compete in real-time discipline duels.
4. **Il Custode della Soglia (Pre-Trade Co-Pilot, Checklist & Risk Circuit-Breaker)**:
   Objective pre-session and pre-trade filter that blocks FOMO and emotional entries. Includes position size and lot calculator, daily-loss circuit-breaker, consecutive-loss guardrails, and volatility/ADR telemetry.
5. **L'Ordine Giornaliero (Ritual Routine & Bio-Emotional Telemetry)**:
   Structured morning alignment and evening debrief protocols, neural respiration centering, heart-rate/HRV bio-tension correlation, and emotional state tracking.
6. **La Dottrina del Tempo (Strategic Video Academy & Mentor Tomes)**:
   Divides market engagement into two inviolable regimes: *L'Arte dell'Assedio* (multi-day HTF Swing structure) and *L'Arte del Duello* (surgical LTF Kill-Zone execution), with doctrinal mastery exams.
7. **Architettura Patrimoniale (5-Pillar Wealth Architecture, Monte Carlo & Prop Firm Engine)**:
   Capital allocation across 5 pillars, 1,000-trajectory Monte Carlo equity simulation, Italian/European tax doctrine reference, and a 2-phase Prop Firm risk & drawdown survival calculator.
8. **Le Prove del Fuoco & La Fratellanza (Live Discipline Arenas & Encrypted Order Agora)**:
   Real-time competitive backtesting arenas with public spectator tribunes (`/duello`), end-to-end encrypted community channels, and *La Gerarchia dell'Integrità* (meritocratic rank system).

## The 5 Ascension Grades (*I 5 Gradi di Ascesa*) & 20% Expansion Mandate

- **Rank Progression**: In AUREUS, rank cannot be bought; it is earned strictly through the **Integrity Index (*Indice di Integrità*)**:
  - **Grade I — Novizio Consapevole**: Entry upon signing the Pact at the Threshold of Selection.
  - **Grade II — Il Custode della Regola**: 30 consecutive sessions at 100% Integrity. Unlocks the **Expansion Mandate (20% recurring royalty = €30/month per active member)**.
  - **Grade III — L'Osservatore Sovrano**: 90 days (1 quarter) of verified consistency. Unlocks speaking rights at the Sunday Council (*Il Concilio della Domenica*) and Order Uniforms.
  - **Grade IV — L'Architetto del Reale**: 180 days of verified mastery. Unlocks Corporate/B2B division and Order Faculty status.
  - **Grade V — Il Maestro Fondatore**: Governing Council & Founding Custodians.

## Access Tiers (*Il Tributo*)

- **Accesso Base (Iniziato — €0/month)**: Free foundational access to *Il Varco*, manual journal, macro news & economic calendar, lot calculator, and basic routine.
- **Soglia di Selezione (€10 Pact)**: Verified candidate initiation and extended sandbox trial.
- **Protocollo Completo (€150/month)**: Full sovereign access to all 6 software modules, automated MT4/MT5 sync, *La Forgia del Passato* backtester, *Le Prove del Fuoco* arenas, *Architettura Patrimoniale*, and the 20% recurring Expansion Mandate (self-funded at 5 invited active operators).
